slice: container format signature detection bounded exact proof slice (narrow decision boundary only)

environment.canonical_lane_os: Windows for mise fmt/check/lint/test/proptest; Ubuntu (WSL2) for Kani execution

input_domain.length: full symbolic usize machine integer domain; no narrowing assume
input_domain.prefix: fixed symbolic [u8; 12]; every byte independently full 8-bit domain
input_domain.trailing_bytes: index 12 and later are outside the maximum observed signature prefix; production helper cannot observe them by type. len 12/13 shell equality is proved as connection evidence, but arbitrary-length shell copy composition remains unproven scope
input_domain.short_input_fillers: prefix positions beyond len remain symbolic in the proof, so accidental filler observation is rejected rather than assumed away

properties.mp4_mid_length: 8 <= len < 12 maps exact offset 4..8 ftyp to Mp4 and everything else to None
properties.riff_exact_mapping: len >= 12 with exact RIFF maps exact WAVE to Wav, exact AVI-with-trailing-space to Avi, and all other form types to None
properties.riff_precedence: len >= 12 RIFF does not fall back to Mp4 even when offset 4..8 is ftyp
properties.non_riff_mp4: len >= 12 non-RIFF maps exact offset 4..8 ftyp to Mp4
properties.tag_exactness: byte order, case, offsets, and AVI trailing space are exact
properties.none_complement: Wav/Avi/Mp4/None form the exact complement in every length class
properties.shell_connection: public detect_format agrees with an independent contract oracle at len 0,7,8,11,12,13 and len 12/13 trailing bytes do not change the result
properties.safety: no overflow, underflow, panic, or invalid indexing in the decision boundary

production_connection.public_shell: crates/al-media/src/format.rs::detect_format captures at most the first 12 bytes with zero filler and passes the original input length plus fixed prefix to the production helper
production_connection.shell_gap: arbitrary-length public input shell copy composition is outside the local exact proof; representative public shell matrix is machine-checked but is not the full input-length proof

mutation.change: production RIFF branch temporarily fell through for unknown RIFF form types, allowing len >= 12 RIFF+ftyp input to be detected as Mp4 instead of preserving unknown-form None

canonical.result: unit 113/113 and all integration/doc suites pass

cost_comparison.scope: limited, not an equivalence proof or complete cost matrix
cost_comparison.comparison: the legacy proof covered representative len 7/8/12 only; the new proof adds full usize length scalar, full 12-byte prefix bit domain, exact precedence/complement, and public shell matrix while remaining in the same small-proof cost class

unproven_scope: arbitrary-length public input shell copy composition beyond the fixed boundary matrix
caller dispatch, probe integration, decode integration, and backend selection
decode_mp4/decode_avi/decode_wav and all container parser correctness
MP4 box scan, sample table, PCM declaration/extraction, timing, writer round-trip
AVI chunk/movi/stream declaration correspondence, timing, PCM, writer round-trip
partial ingest/capability observation and corruption/mutation/truncation whole-parser safety
public API-wide no-panic, I/O, allocation, diagnostic formatting
recognition of MP4 files leading with free/wide/styp/mdat/moov; the current contract intentionally returns None

runner_strategy.proof_family_split: not needed; decision proof and shell matrix fit one practical harness
rejected_decompositions: direct public API fixed-length matrix only
decode dispatch or whole-container signature proof

proptest_overlap.relationship: the formal proof covers the pure decision core exactly; proptest covers public integration statistically
unit_regressions_added: RIFF+ftyp competition and unknown RIFF non-fallback

legacy_disposition: legacy detect_format_signature_rules remains registered legacy inventory; no retire or deletion decision in this slice

rf_reuse.candidate: generic fixed magic-byte prefix decision proof shape may be reusable
rf_reuse.reason_not_promoted: the contract is still coupled to AudioLens MediaFormat, RIFF precedence, unknown-form non-fallback, leading-ftyp-only recognition, and None interpretation; no independently proven reusable contract exists yet
